adultDescription: A fog-wader that lifts one wing and the morning goes quiet.
babyDescription: A cupful of fog that grew a bill and a staring problem.

cosmetics.lore: They think you're the porch light. Every night, all three of them, absolutely certain.
cosmetics.name: Moth Hour

description: Hushwing does not land; it condenses. It wades the low fog on legs you can never quite focus on, standing so still that frogs use it for shade. It turns up before you wake, watches the porch for about as long as a kettle takes, then leaves without a sound - but it always tips one wing on the way out. That is as close as weather gets to saying hello.

history.change: cosmetics withheld pending the v1.8.1 pack parser

dex-edit: baseColor #8FA8BE -> #99B7DD, clearing echowl at 5.0 and latchback at 6.6 — the worst pair on the board, near the ~2.3 just-noticeable difference. W64-ROSTER wants dE00 >= 10 between any two species and only ever measured the fourteen COMPILED ones, so no pack species had been checked against anything since the registry began (B343). Measured across the whole 32-species roster; this is the smallest move that clears 11 against all 31 others. Four pack species were moved rather than eight, because every colliding pair has a pack species in it and the compiled roster needs no change at all.

name: Hushwing
teenDescription: All neck and patience. Has not blinked since Tuesday.
